CENTRAL STATION Station.
D. 11th August 1919.

REPORT ON Departure of Mrs Ettinger.

Made by D. S. I. Givens. Forwarded by Chief Detective Officer.

Sir,
Mrs. Ettinger left Shanghai by train on 9th instant, and
it is believed that she has gone to join her husband, who is
said to be living in Changchun, where he is staying at the
Yamato Hotel. Previous to her departure Mrs Ettinger lived
at No. 14 Nanzing Road.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
J. Givens
D. S. I.

C. D. O.

第 9 号登记册
上海公共租界工部局警务处 第 2975 号
日期：1919 年 8 月 12 日

中央巡捕房。
1919 年 8 月 11 日。

关于艾廷格夫人 (Mrs Ettinger) 离境的报告。

由副督察吉文斯 (D. S. I. Givens) 呈报。经首席侦探官转呈。

先生，
艾廷格夫人已于本月 9 日乘火车离开上海，
据信她已前往与其丈夫团聚，其丈夫据称
居住在长春，下榻于大和旅馆 (Yamato Hotel)。在离境前，艾廷格夫人居住于
南京路 14 号。

此致，
您顺从的仆人，
J. 吉文斯
副督察

首席侦探官

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION DEPARTMENT,

Shanghai, August 7th 19 19

Sir,

Attached is photo of a passport
issued by the Bureau of Foreign Affairs
to the wife of a Turk and presented at
the Japanese Consulate on August 7th for
signature.

The signature is being withheld
by the Consul General and the Bureau
of Foreign Affairs communicated with.

Your obedient servant,

（签名）
i/c C.I.D.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

PASS-PORT

This is to certify that Mrs. D. Ettinger, a
Jewish subject, is proceeding from .... to
Dalny, Changchun and other places to travel
with .....companions ..... and .... articles
of baggage. The undersigned requests the
Authorities of the districts concerned to
lend all assistance necessary. The holder
is strictly warned not to proceed to the
districts in an unsettled and dangerous
condition and some barbarious districts
in the interior of Kwangtung, Kwangse and
Yunnan Provinces.
This Pass-port will be available for thirteen
months from date of issue.

(sd) Yang Tcheng.
Commissioner of Foreign Affairs,
Shanghai.

The 4th day of the 8th moon
of the 8th year of the
Republic of China.
